name: nyxara
description: Local-first AI orchestration for software engineering

scripts.vscode:build: node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/provider-sdk/tsconfig.json && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/tools/tsconfig.json && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/providers/tsconfig.json && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p apps/vscode/tsconfig.json && node_modules/.bin/esbuild apps/vscode/src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=apps/vscode/dist/extension.cjs
scripts.vscode:package: npm run vscode:build && npm run vscode:test && mkdir -p dist/vscode && cd apps/vscode && ../../node_modules/.bin/vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --out ../../dist/vscode/nyxara-vscode-0.1.0-alpha.1.vsix
scripts.benchmark:local: tsc -p packages/provider-sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/providers/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/benchmark/tsconfig.json && node tools/benchmark/dist/cli.js
